status: post-result locked attribution audit; not a new independent replication
scientific_question: Does the frozen Phase 1.21 acquisition rule add value beyond both M3 probability margin and the historical Week 8.5 Binary-GPC margin policy when query paths are evaluated by the identical frozen M3 evaluator?

naming_guard.M3_margin_incumbent: The policy called A0_m3_margin in Phase 2.2; M3 probability-margin selection with the frozen B16 design.
naming_guard.historical_binary_A0: The original Week 8.5 isotropic Binary-GPC binary_margin policy/path; distinct from M3 margin.
naming_guard.historical_binary_A0_live: A live sequential recreation of the frozen historical Binary-GPC margin policy on repeats 61-120; it must not be described as the stored A0 path.

population.label: has_keyhole; manual any-observed-frame Keyhole ground truth

splits.inference_unit: paired repeat mean after averaging the five folds
splits.interpretation: same-population internal attribution; not external validation and not a second independent confirmation

existing_arms_read_only.margin: M3 probability margin, frozen B16 seed
existing_arms_read_only.coverage_then_margin_B40: Candidate A, frozen B16 seed; pure acquisition contrast against margin
existing_arms_read_only.early8__coverage_then_margin_B40: Candidate B, early-8 seed; composite contrast against margin

new_arms.early8__margin: same early-8 seed and sequential both-class extension as Candidate B, followed by plain M3 probability margin
new_arms.historical_binary_A0_live: same frozen B16 seed; old isotropic Binary-GPC probability-margin selector run live; every prefix evaluated by frozen M3

locked_new_primary_contrasts.question: Does coverage add acquisition value after holding the early start fixed?
With the same B16 start and M3 evaluator, is Candidate A's path better than the historical Binary-GPC margin policy?

known_result_not_retested.role: existing Phase 1.21 preregistered pure-acquisition result; numbers and artifacts will be parity-checked but not treated as a new discovery

endpoint_hierarchy.new_primary: Fold-B1-q20 accuracy AULC B16-B80 for each of the two locked new contrasts
secondary: Fold-B1-q30 accuracy and balanced-accuracy AULC B16-B40 and B16-B80
positive repeat count and query-path overlap
endpoint_hierarchy.metric_guard: accuracy and balanced-accuracy AULCs are reported separately and never compared numerically as the same endpoint
endpoint_hierarchy.q_guard: q20 remains primary; q30 is secondary

inference.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap of 60 repeat means, 20000 deterministic draws
inference.test: paired two-sided exact/Monte-Carlo sign-flip test on repeat means
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two new primary contrasts only
inference.statistical_superiority: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, paired 95% interval lower bound > 0, and both guardrails pass
inference.practical_replacement: statistical superiority plus mean primary AULC gain >= 0.01

mandatory_preexecution_gates: stored Phase 1.21 margin/A/B checkpoints pass schema, split, path and metric completeness checks
the historical Binary-GPC implementation reproduces all 100 canonical stored A0 paths byte-for-byte or by exact full query sequence
an early16 M3-margin gate reproduces stored Phase 1.21 margin paths and metrics under the matching single-thread numerical environment
selector interfaces exclude held-out labels, hidden candidate labels and q20/q30/B1 membership
checkpoint reuse is fail-closed on protocol, source, population, split and payload hashes
stop_rules: stop on any source/protocol/hash/parity/leakage gate failure
do not repair or tune a policy after observing a new comparator result
do not run another acquisition search
do not call this external validation
